title: Create Homing Projectile
important_information: Homing projectiles heal/damage players or owned entities, fail at entity capacity, and never affect their owner regardless of selected team.
Null owner gives nobody credit; null start/direction use owner eye position/facing; relativity affects both position and direction.
Amount Scalar means critical-hit multiplier when explosion radius is zero, but damage at the explosion edge when radius is positive; explosion visuals/sounds are omitted at radius zero.
Oversize spans 0–1 with a projectile-specific maximum; speed is meters/second, lifetime seconds, and explosion impulse affects all affected targets.
Null homing target means straight flight; strength 0 gives no following and 1 follows aggressively without losing target.
Projectiles extension unlocks more types.
evidence: Amount Scalar; Explosion Effect; Explosion Sound Effect

title: Create Projectile
important_information: Projectile entities heal/damage players and owned entities, fail at entity capacity, and never affect the owner regardless of affected team.

title: Start Forcing Throttle

title: Start Game Mode
important_information: Start Game Mode has no effect when the game is already in progress.

title: Start Heal Over Time
important_information: HoT persists until duration expiry or script stop and exposes Last Heal Over Time ID for cleanup.
Null healer gives no credit; long duration such as 9999 is suggested for script-controlled expiry.

title: Start Healing Modification
important_information: Healing modifiers affect receiver/healer pairs, expose Last Healing Modification ID, and have a maximum of 64 active instances; selected inputs can reevaluate.

title: Start Holding Button
important_information: Start Holding Button creates persistent virtual input until Stop Holding Button.

title: Start Modifying Hero Voice Lines
important_information: Hero voice pitch scalar range is documented as 0.5–1.5; reevaluation true updates it every frame, false samples once.
uncertainties: Default 0 lies outside documented range; Player property mistakenly describes movement collision.

title: Start Rule
important_information: Start Rule runs a subroutine simultaneously without pausing the caller and inherits the caller's event context.
If no corresponding subroutine exists it is ignored; Already Executing policy is scoped to the same player/global entity and defaults to Restart Rule.

title: Start Scaling Barriers
important_information: Barrier scale is a multiplier (0.5 halves, 2 doubles); enabled reevaluation updates every frame, otherwise scale is sampled once.

title: Start Scaling Player
important_information: Player scaling changes movement collision, hit detection and certain abilities as well as appearance.
Large players in complex environments can severely increase server load; article suggests disabling environment movement collision.
Scale is a multiplier, sampled every frame only when reevaluation is enabled.

title: Start Throttle In Direction
important_information: Starting throttle-in-direction cancels any previous instance; it can replace or add to existing input.
Direction is normalized in selected world/local space; magnitude 1 is full input, with selected direction/magnitude reevaluation.

title: Start Transforming Throttle
important_information: Transforming throttle cancels a previous transform; it scales left/right X and forward/back Y before rotating input.
Axis scalars and relative direction always reevaluate every frame; relative direction is normalized.
Supplying camera-facing direction makes movement camera-relative.
evidence: Description; X Axis Scalar; Y Axis Scalar; Relative Direction

title: Wait
important_information: Wait's documented minimum is 0.016s at 62.5 ticks/s; durations round upward to tick intervals (0.030→0.032, 0.1→0.112).
Wait Behavior uses the rule condition list to choose ignore, abort or restart behavior.
uncertainties: Tick timing is archived, not live verified; wording 'divisible by tickrate' should be rewritten as tick interval multiples.
Brief action reference does not describe all event/condition edge cases.

title: Wait Until
important_information: Wait Until ends when its continue predicate is true or timeout elapses; it ignores the rule's conditions during the wait.
It may pass after zero ticks and has no one-tick minimum.
uncertainties: Action reference omits predicate invalidation/reevaluation pitfalls reported elsewhere; do not treat it as a complete polling model.

title: While
important_information: While tests its condition at loop top and exits to the action after the matching same-level End when false.

title: element cost of actions
important_information: Element table is measured with stock argument values, not a fixed per-action cost independent of expressions; empty rules/events cost one in this table.
The complete article is a lookup catalog suitable for generated/reference data rather than mandatory prose.
uncertainties: Dated 2024-03-16; names contain typos and no measurement method/version is supplied; avoid treating counts as current total cost formulas.

title: Ongoing - Each Player
important_information: Ongoing Each Player is rising-edge triggered per player: all conditions must become true; staying true on subsequent ticks does not retrigger, and at least one must become false to rearm.
Conditions are checked each server tick; with no conditions, it fires immediately whenever a player loads into the game.
Team and hero/slot filters determine the associated players; Event Player is the triggering player.
uncertainties: Page does not describe active-rule retriggers or what changing hero/slot filters does to an executing rule.

title: Ongoing - Global
important_information: Ongoing Global is rising-edge triggered: conditions remaining true do not retrigger; at least one must become false to rearm.
Conditions check every server tick; without conditions it fires immediately at server start.
evidence: Full body, first and second paragraphs

title: Player Dealt Damage
important_information: Dealt Damage includes self-damage and checks rule conditions when the event occurs.
Event Player and Attacker are the damage dealer; Victim is receiver (same as attacker for self-damage). Context includes Event Damage, critical hit, Event Ability and incoming Event Direction.
uncertainties: Page omits concurrency/retrigger handling and does not establish event behavior for barriers/owned objects.

title: Player Dealt Final Blow
important_information: Final Blow includes suicide; Event Player/Attacker is the killer and Victim is the dying player, all equal on suicide.
Context includes final damage amount, critical hit, Event Ability and incoming Event Direction; this event is distinct from merely earning elimination credit.

title: Player Dealt Healing
important_information: Dealt Healing includes self-healing; Event Player equals Healer, Healee is recipient (same for self-heal). Context includes Event Healing, Event Was Health Pack, Event Ability and incoming Event Direction.

title: Player Dealt Knockback
important_information: Dealt Knockback includes self-knockback; Event Player equals Attacker, Victim is receiver; context also exposes Event Ability and incoming Event Direction.

title: Player Died
important_information: Player Died has Event Player equal Victim; Attacker is final-blow dealer (same on suicide). Context exposes received damage, critical hit, ability and incoming direction.

title: Player Earned Elimination
important_information: Earned Elimination triggers on elimination credit, with Event Player/Attacker equal the credited player and Victim the credited victim.
Page lists damage, critical-hit, ability and direction context as available.
uncertainties: Context details for non-final-blow elimination credit are not further explained; avoid assuming this equals Final Blow.

title: Player Joined Match
important_information: Joined Match runs at player join only if its conditions are true and exposes Event Player.

title: Player Left Match
important_information: By Player Left Match, that player's variables and all other information about them are no longer available; Event Player is still listed as the trigger reference.

title: Player Received Healing
important_information: Received Healing includes self-healing; Event Player equals Healee, while Healer is source (equal for self-heal). Context includes Event Healing, health-pack flag, ability and incoming direction.

title: Player Received Knockback
important_information: Received Knockback includes self-knockback; Event Player equals Victim, Attacker is source; context also supplies Event Ability and incoming Event Direction.

title: Player Took Damage
important_information: Took Damage includes self-damage and checks rule conditions on event; Event Player equals Victim, Attacker is source (equal for self-damage).
Context supplies received damage, critical-hit flag, ability and incoming direction.
uncertainties: Page omits active-rule concurrency/retrigger handling; it does not contradict tutorial-specific rules but does not independently explain them.

title: Subroutine
important_information: Subroutine events are manually triggered via Call Subroutine/Start Rule, cannot have conditions, and inherit calling rule context.
